observations: The old owner/name endpoint redirects to the numeric repository endpoint /repositories/2126244.
The current owner/name endpoint reports repository id 2126244.
Thus, in this one source-qualified historical move/rename case, the old logical path and current logical path resolve to the same numeric repository identity.
inferences_with_scope_guard: This empirically supports repository.id continuity for this specific moved repository, but does not prove an API-wide invariant for every rename or transfer.
The old redirect payload does not expose node_id, so node_id continuity was not directly observed in this leaf.
Nothing in this experiment proves non-reuse of repository id or node_id after deletion, nor that an old owner/name redirect survives if the old logical path is reused.
